entitycount.config.master_toggle.tooltip: Enable or disable entity count display
entitycount.config.display_mode.tooltip: All: Show all entities | Living: Show only living entities
entitycount.config.filter_mode.tooltip: Blacklist: Hide blacklisted entities | Whitelist: Show only whitelisted entities
entitycount.config.text_color.tooltip: Set the text color for entity count display
entitycount.config.background_color.tool: Set the background color and transparency for entity count display
entitycount.config.text_scale.tooltip: Adjust the text scaling for entity count display
entitycount.config.type_limit.tooltip: Limit the maximum number of entity types displayed, -1 means unlimited
entitycount.config.threshold.tooltip: Only display entity types with count greater than or equal to this value, -1 means no limit
entitycount.config.position_x.tooltip: Adjust horizontal position of entity count display (0.0 = left, 1.0 = right)
entitycount.config.position_y.tooltip: Adjust vertical position of entity count display (0.0 = top, 1.0 = bottom)
entitycount.config.whitelist.tooltip: Only show entities in this list (when filter mode is whitelist)
entitycount.config.blacklist.tooltip: Hide entities in this list (when filter mode is blacklist)
entitycount.config.pinnedlist.tooltip: Entities in this list will always be displayed at the top (even if count is 0)
entitycount.config.hint: Click and drag the display box to adjust position
entitycount.config.expand_item_display.t: Show detailed item names for dropped items (e.g., Item.Diamond)
